finalText:
**Big but shallow: 1082 hits in 94 files.** Most are one repeated pattern per layer.

| Zone | Files | Hits | Rename? |
|---|---|---|---|
| `services/*` repo, service, http | 75 | 1025 | Yes, safe |
| `lib/audit.js` | 1 | 2 | Yes |
| `migrations/*.sql` | 12 | 37 | No |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk` | 4 | 12 | No |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | 1 | 5 | No |
| `lib/serialize.js` | 1 | 1 | No |

Four hard stops. `docs/openapi.yaml` calls the field frozen, so `WIRE` in [serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8) must keep `account_id` on the right. Applied migrations are history. `vendor/` is regenerated by `npm run vendor:refresh`.

One more trap. SQL strings inside repo files name the real column. Rename the JS var, keep `WHERE account_id = ?` until a migration renames the column.
